Active
Updated: 19 Jul 2026

Saldanha Real Estate Private Limited, is an unlisted private company incorporated on 10 June, 2015. It is classified as a private limited company and is located in Mumbai City, Maharashtra. It's authorized share capital is INR 50.00 lac and the total paid-up capital is INR 32.00 lac.

The current status of Saldanha Real Estate Private Limited is - Active.


The last reported AGM (Annual General Meeting) of Saldanha Real Estate Private Limited, per our records, was held on 30 September, 2022.

The company has two directors - Allwyn Angelo Saldanha and Geraldine Ruth Saldanha.

The Corporate Identification Number (CIN) of Saldanha Real Estate Private Limited is U70102MH2015PTC265382. It's registered address is at SALCETTE CATHOLIC CHS, FLAT NO.1, PLOT NO.29,, 56, HILL ROAD, OPP. BATA SHOE SHOP, BANDRA (WEST), MUMBAI, Mumbai City, Maharashtra - 400050.
